Questa mattina ha reso le Comunicazioni al Senato della Repubblica ed a seguire l'intervento di replica.

Governo.titolo: Convocazione del Consiglio dei Ministri n. 192
Governo.descrizione: Il Consiglio dei ministri è convocato oggi, martedì 13 ottobre 2026, alle ore 19:00 a Palazzo Chigi, per l’esame del seguente ordine del giorno:

Commissione, notizie.titolo: New analysis on digital forensic gaps and needs of EU law enforcement
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The European Commission, in close cooperation with Europol, has conducted a gap and needs analysis to assess the current state of digital forensic capabilities across EU. The report provides recommendations to strengthen EU-wide digital forensic capabilities.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Announcement of next auction (EU-Bills) on 21-10-2026
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: Auction announcement EU-Bills.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: COP17: EU delivering on global targets to protect nature and biodiversity
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The 17th United Nations Biodiversity Conference (CBD COP17) starts in Yerevan next week, as hopes of building a consensus begin.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Horizon Europe launches a new research and innovation call on nature
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The call aims to increase biodiversity spending in the Horizon Europe Work Programme 2026-2027 by supporting additional R&I activities dedicated to biodiversity across Pillar II.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: New strategy on combating trafficking in human beings
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The European Commission sets out a new strategy to combat trafficking in human beings. The Strategy is accompanied by the 6th progress report with data from 2023 and 2024 on combatting trafficking in human beings.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Europe expands access, sharing and use of research data and digital services through first 13 Open Science Cloud hubs
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The hubs, known as EOSC Nodes, connect resources from different research organisations, helping researchers work across countries and scientific disciplines.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: From plants and waste to everyday products: boosting Europe’s bioeconomy
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: EU-funded researchers are developing alternatives to fossil-based materials, from packaging to fertilisers. Their work could cut Europe's reliance on oil and gas and inspire international cooperation.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: ERA Living Guidelines on the responsible use of Generative AI in research updated
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The most extensive revision of the ERA Living Guidelines to date. It introduces new recommendations and clarifications on the responsible use of Generative AI in research.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Commissioner Jørgensen in Slovakia to discuss energy prices and security with Visegrad Energy Ministers and continue his Affordable Housing Tour
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: On Monday, 19 October, Commissioner for Energy and Housing Dan Jørgensen will be in Bratislava, Slovakia, to discuss high energy prices and security of supply with the energy ministers of the Visegrad Group (Czechia, Hungary, Poland and Slovakia).

Commissione, notizie.titolo: New information alert in the Schengen Information System to improve security
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The Schengen Information System has enhanced capabilities to fight terrorism and serious organised crime. A new information alert will make information shared by non-EU countries and international organisations on suspected terrorists and serious criminals available across the EU in real time.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Steady progress on the One Europe, One Market roadmap
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: In their second review of the joint declaration and roadmap, designed to boost economic growth, the EU institutions reaffirmed their commitment to timely delivery.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Decameal: turning overabundant shore crabs into valuable food and feed ingredients
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: What to do with an overabundance of crabs disrupting the Danish coastal ecosystem? Danish biologists Leander Hessner and Happylan Natkunarajah had the idea to turn this underused resource into a new source of marine protein.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Commission hosts a high-level policy dialogue on the role of forest-based value chains in the EU’s climate transition
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: Today, Commissioner for Climate, Net Zero and Clean Growth, Wopke Hoekstra brought together representatives of forest owners and the pulp and paper sector for a high-level policy dialogue on Europe’s forest-based value chains.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Working together to build Europe’s digital future
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: How can Europe prepare its workforce for a digital future? At CodeWeek: The Future Is Now, education, industry and policymakers came together in Brussels to explore how collaboration, lifelong learning and inclusive digital education can help bridge the skills gap and ensure no one is left behind.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Mayors meet with EU leaders in Brussels to advance affordable energy and climate resilience
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: This year’s Covenant of Mayors Ceremony highlighted how cooperation between EU and local leaders is essential to protect Europeans from price shocks and climate risks.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: EU hosts first international conference on protecting aid workers
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The EU has mobilised €3.5 million in funding in 2026 for the safety of humanitarian workers through the Protect Aid Workers initiative. It provides protection measures, post-incident assistance and legal support to humanitarian staff exposed to threats and violence.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Staying one step ahead of breast cancer, our talk with Europa Donna
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: Our interview with the largest breast cancer patient advocacy organisation in Europe during Pink October

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Apply now to be a European Climate Pact Ambassador!
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: You have until 31 October 2026 to submit your European Climate Pact Ambassador application. Applications are assessed on a rolling basis – so early applications are welcome!

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Screening of foreign direct investment continues to advance EU security and public order
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The European Commission closely cooperates with EU governments on screening investments from third countries to assess potential threats to European security or public order, shows a report published today.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: EU Water Resilience Investment Accelerator: Supporting financing for water-related projects
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The newly announced initiative will bring together investors and solution providers to support financing for water-related projects.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: 12.3 kg of e-waste collected per person in the EU
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: This compares with 32.4 kg of new electrical and electronic equipment per person put on the EU market during the same year.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: EU local leaders and authorities gather to discuss affordable energy, housing and climate resilience
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: Tomorrow, hundreds of mayors, local and regional leaders and representatives from across Europe will come together in Brussels to participate in the EU Covenant of Mayors Ceremony 2026.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Making social protection information in Europe easier to compare and understand
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: New comparative tables and a set of infographics by Mutual Information System on Social Protection (MISSOC) offer a more accessible and user-friendly way to explore social protection systems across Europe.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Commission proposes flexibility to methane importers to help save costs
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The Commission proposes a one-year flexibility for importers on the methane regulation's monitoring and verification requirements, delaying the 2027 obligations to help save costs amid the energy crisis.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Growing use of AI in European companies
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: According to a new Eurobarometer survey, 63% of European small and medium sized enterprises (SMEs) and mid-cap companies already use (42%) artificial intelligence (AI) and algorithmic management (AM) or plan to do so in the coming years (21%).

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Commission allocates €168.2 million to boost Europe's defence production under the European Defence Industry Programme
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The European Commission has allocated €168.2 million to support the first eight projects under the Industrial Reinforcement Action (IRA) pillar of the European Defence Industry Programme (EDIP).

Commissione, notizie.titolo: EU signs Protocol to strengthen asset recovery and anti-money laundering cooperation
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: On 14 October, the EU signed the Additional Protocol to the Council of Europe Convention on Laundering, Search, Seizure and Confiscation of the Proceeds from Crime and on the Financing of Terrorism. With strengthened rules, it will also facilitate cooperation and prevention.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Commissioners Lahbib and Kubilius strengthen global disaster risk management through space technologies
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: Space services support all phases of the disaster management cycle, from preparedness and prevention with forecasts and early warnings to mapping in support of emergency response and recovery assessments after the disasters.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Team Europe strengthens support for Thailand’s climate resilience and water management
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The European Union has announced new financial support for the improvement of the irrigation system in the Lower East Chao Phraya river basin, including a €12 million grant to be blended with a loan from the French Development Agency (AFD) and co-financed with the Asian Development Bank.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Commission accepts commitments by Sanofi to address possible anticompetitive disparagement of competing flu vaccine for vulnerable patients
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The European Commission has made commitments offered by Sanofi legally binding under EU antitrust rules. The commitments relate to the Commission's preliminary competition concerns relating to Sanofi's alleged disparagement campaigns in Germany and France against Fluad...
